text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! Did you watch me run?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! Did you watch me run?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Hehe! It's only because I had so much
fun running
with Grass! ♪
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
And I'm just as happy to see how much
she's
grown!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
I can't stop thinking about the possibility
of
running with her again in the future!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Now, I wonder which race I should run in
next to
show everyone what I've got.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
There are several choices, but she'll
want a race
where she can enjoy
competing against other
excellent
runners...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Let's go for the autumn Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.text:
That's a great idea! It's the perfect
distance, and I
like Tokyo because it
feels like home!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Radical! I can't wait to run in the fall
Tenno!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Марузенски.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Oh, Grass! That was a great race!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Yes, it was a really good race...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
But even though I tried my best, I
couldn't catch
up to you.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I keep thinking about what I could have
done
differently. It's terribly frustrating...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Still, when I look in your eyes now, I see your determination clear as day. In fact, it's growing.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
You're right. I'm going to keep training
and make
sure that one day, I'll be the
one who wins.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. It's fun to help each other
improve, isn't it?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
It sure is! I'm so glad you had a fun race
too.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Since we enjoyed it so much, I'm sure the
people
who were watching must have
liked it as well.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
There may be people out there who are
eager to
run with us right now!
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Heehee! I'm looking forward to running
against
them too!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
After a great race with Грасс Вандер,

Марузенски's next target is the autumn
Tenno
Sho!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
What a great race! I was cheering so
hard I
thought I might lose my voice!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text: I wish I could run in a race like that too!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text: Yeah... I wish I could too!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик
